verdict.rationale: Ramp CLI explicitly supports headless/CI automation via `--agent` JSON output, `--no-input` for CI, OAuth client-credentials login for standalone agents without a browser, and RAMP_PROFILE for pinned automation identities, plus a documented Developer API/OpenAPI schema and webhooks for server-to-server workflows — all independently verified by live probes (401 OAuth-gated MCP, 200 developer MCP, 174-path OpenAPI). missing for 10: no independent third-party report of a real CI pipeline using the CLI in production, only first-party docs and probes.
